items.prompt: True or false: The letter H has a line of symmetry.
hints: Draw a line down the middle.
items.explanation: If you fold H down the middle, both sides match. So it has a line of symmetry.

items.prompt: True or false: A rectangle that is longer than it is wide has exactly 2 lines of symmetry.
hints: Fold a rectangle in half in your mind.
You can fold it lengthways and widthways.
Count the folds that match exactly.
items.explanation: A rectangle that is not a square has 2 lines of symmetry: one across the middle and one down the middle.
